content.json:
## usnm OCR nodes
The on-prem OCR nodes (#296, 12 Step 3), from their own workspace `usnm-ocr-log-<env>`: the Azure Monitor Agent's `Heartbeat`, `Perf` (every 60 s) and `Syslog`, the worker's Application Insights telemetry (component `usnm-ocr-appi-<env>`, tables `AppTraces`, `AppExceptions` and `AppMetrics`, once the worker sends it) and the workspace's `Usage`. Nodes are listed from their heartbeats in the last 30 days. Times are UTC. The same views as text: `scripts/logs.sh --env <env> --query-name ocr-node-health` and `ocr-node-errors`.

content.query:
let machines = "/providers/microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/";
let node_of = (id: string) { tolower(extract(@"(?i)/machines/([^/]+)$", 1, id)) };
let perf = union isfuzzy=true
    (Perf
    | where _ResourceId has machines
    | project TimeGenerated, Node = node_of(_ResourceId), ObjectName, CounterName, InstanceName, CounterValue),
    (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime, Node: string, ObjectName: string, CounterName: string, InstanceName: string,
        CounterValue: real)[])
    | where Node in ({Nodes});
// The total instance is the average over the CPUs.
perf
| where ObjectName == "Processor" and CounterName == "% Processor Time" and InstanceName == "total"
| summarize CpuPct = round(avg(CounterValue), 1) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Node
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: CPU, %

content.query:
let machines = "/providers/microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/";
let node_of = (id: string) { tolower(extract(@"(?i)/machines/([^/]+)$", 1, id)) };
let perf = union isfuzzy=true
    (Perf
    | where _ResourceId has machines
    | project TimeGenerated, Node = node_of(_ResourceId), ObjectName, CounterName, InstanceName, CounterValue),
    (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime, Node: string, ObjectName: string, CounterName: string, InstanceName: string,
        CounterValue: real)[])
    | where Node in ({Nodes});
// The counters are bytes since boot: the rate is the difference between
// samples over the time between them. A drop (a reboot) gives no rate.
perf
| where ObjectName == "Network" and CounterName in ("Total Bytes Received", "Total Bytes Transmitted") and InstanceName == "total"
| extend Series = strcat(Node, iff(CounterName endswith "Received", " received", " sent"))
| order by Series asc, TimeGenerated asc
| extend Rate = iff(prev(Series) == Series and CounterValue >= prev(CounterValue),
    (CounterValue - prev(CounterValue)) / ((TimeGenerated - prev(TimeGenerated)) / 1s), real(null))
| where isnotnull(Rate)
| summarize BytesPerSec = avg(Rate) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Series
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Network received and sent, bytes/s

content.query:
let machines = "/providers/microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/";
let node_of = (id: string) { tolower(extract(@"(?i)/machines/([^/]+)$", 1, id)) };
// Syslog: the worker's JSON lines (local0, identifier usnm-ocr-worker) at
// WARN and ERROR, and any line that isn't JSON (a panic, a bad flag) as TEXT.
let syslog = union isfuzzy=true
    (Syslog
    | where _ResourceId has machines
    | where Facility == "local0" or ProcessName == "usnm-ocr-worker"
    | project TimeGenerated, Node = node_of(_ResourceId), SyslogMessage),
    (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime, Node: string, SyslogMessage: string)[])
    | where Node in ({Nodes})
    | extend j = parse_json(SyslogMessage)
    | extend Level = iff(isnotempty(tostring(j.level)), tostring(j.level), "TEXT")
    | where Level in ("WARN", "ERROR", "TEXT")
    | extend Message = iff(Level == "TEXT", replace_regex(substring(SyslogMessage, 0, 120), @"\d+", "N"),
        strcat(tostring(j.fields.message), iff(isnotempty(tostring(j.fields.kind)), strcat(" (", tostring(j.fields.kind), ")"), "")))
    | extend Example = substring(iff(Level == "TEXT", SyslogMessage,
        strcat(tostring(j.fields.page), " ", coalesce(tostring(j.fields.error), tostring(j.fields.cause)))), 0, 300)
    | project TimeGenerated, Node, Source = "syslog", Level, Message, Example;
// Application Insights, once the worker sends telemetry: its warnings and
// errors as traces (SeverityLevel 2 and up) and its exceptions. The same
// lines also reach Syslog, so a line can show under both sources.
let traces = union isfuzzy=true
    (AppTraces | where AppRoleName == "usnm-ocr-worker" and SeverityLevel >= 2
    | project TimeGenerated, AppRoleInstance, SeverityLevel, Text = Message),
    (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime, AppRoleInstance: string, SeverityLevel: int, Text: string)[])
    | project TimeGenerated, Node = tolower(AppRoleInstance), Source = "traces",
        Level = iff(SeverityLevel >= 3, "ERROR", "WARN"),
        Message = replace_regex(substring(Text, 0, 120), @"\d+", "N"), Example = substring(Text, 0, 300);
let exceptions = union isfuzzy=true
    (AppExceptions | where AppRoleName == "usnm-ocr-worker"
    | project TimeGenerated, AppRoleInstance, ExceptionType, OuterMessage),
    (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime, AppRoleInstance: string, ExceptionType: string, OuterMessage: string)[])
    | project TimeGenerated, Node = tolower(AppRoleInstance), Source = "exceptions", Level = "ERROR",
        Message = strcat(ExceptionType, ": ", replace_regex(substring(OuterMessage, 0, 120), @"\d+", "N")),
        Example = substring(OuterMessage, 0, 300);
let lines = union syslog, traces, exceptions
    | where Node in ({Nodes});
lines
| summarize Lines = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Series = strcat(Node, " ", Level)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Worker warnings and errors
content.noDataMessage: No worker warnings or errors in the time range.

    | project TimeGenerated, AppRoleInstance, SeverityLevel, Text = Message),
    (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime, AppRoleInstance: string, SeverityLevel: int, Text: string)[])
    | project TimeGenerated, Node = tolower(AppRoleInstance), Source = "traces",
        Level = iff(SeverityLevel >= 3, "ERROR", "WARN"),
        Message = replace_regex(substring(Text, 0, 120), @"\d+", "N"), Example = substring(Text, 0, 300);

    (AppExceptions | where AppRoleName == "usnm-ocr-worker"

content.query:
// Per day, newest first: billed MB, the share of the daily cap and MB by
// table (Usage). The cap as in the chart.
let cap_mb = todouble("__CAP_GB__") * 1000;
union isfuzzy=true
    (Usage | where IsBillable | project TimeGenerated, DataType, Quantity),
    (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime, DataType: string, Quantity: real)[])
| summarize MB = sum(Quantity) by Day = startofday(TimeGenerated), DataType
| summarize ByTable = make_bag(bag_pack(DataType, round(MB, 2))), MB = round(sum(MB), 2) by Day
| extend CapMB = cap_mb, CapPct = round(100 * MB / cap_mb, 1)
| project Day, MB, CapMB, CapPct, ByTable
| order by Day desc
content.title: Billed MB a day by table
